experiment: Trip 10: the REAL capture engine with capture_read=pio,dma, crc32, no end read-back, 4096 sectors at FAD 45150 on MDK2. Three bench runs in the log: the first had a non-GD disc in the drive and measured nothing (the new guard said so); the other two are the result.

inputs.note: Log truncated: YES (the top, including the build line, was lost; every result line survived)

conclusions: The real engine gains +34.8% (715.6 to 964.9 KiB/s, two runs within 0.5%), against +34.1% for the bare loop in Trip 9: EDC, checkpoints and planning cost the overlap nothing.
Disc time fell from 3730 ms to 145 ms: 96.1% of it now hides behind the SD write.
The first run had a CD with no high-density area in the drive and ended 'BENCH complete but NOTHING was measured': the guard added on 2026-09-20 working on hardware for the first time.

limitations: MDK2 at FAD 45150 only; a bench capture publishes nothing, so correctness is proven by Trip 11, not here.
